import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

# Read and aggregate the CSV to one revenue value per month and region.
df = pd.read_csv('/mnt/uploads/sales.csv')
grouped = df.groupby(['month', 'region'], as_index=False)['revenue'].sum()
pivot = grouped.pivot(index='month', columns='region', values='revenue').sort_index()

fig, ax = plt.subplots()
for region in pivot.columns:
    ax.plot(pivot.index, pivot[region], marker='o', label=region)
ax.set_xlabel('Month')
ax.set_ylabel('Revenue')
ax.set_title('Revenue by Month and Region')
ax.legend(title='Region')
ax.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
fig.tight_layout()
